correctness.rationale: For every n≥3 and all 2^n subsets, graph-state cut entropy equals the GF(2) cut-adjacency rank. Any cut having a noncrossing edge decomposes uniquely into path runs, whose independent binary matrix ranks equal ceil(L/2). The written four-state transition gives exactly one closed path per such cut. At even n=2m the two fully alternating cuts have rank(I+P)=m−1, while the cyclic phase-tracking trace counts each twice at rank m; the explicit correction replaces precisely these terms. At odd n none exists. The eigenvalue reduction at z=1, derivative identities and analytic dominant eigenvalue prove first moment, variance asymptotic and CLT for all n, not just enumerated n. A standalone independent GF(2) elimination check agrees with every transfer coefficient for all n=3..15 and with the n=12,k=6 exact table. Finite checks corroborate and are not used as an all-n proof. Limits and boundaries are explicit.
